per_claim.note: Independent SPAdes assembly size (6,509,452 bp) matches paper (6,509,961 bp) within 0.008%.
GC content matches exactly (66.26%) on independently assembled S3 contigs ≥1 kb.

Contig count differs (paper 63 after MeDuSa scaffolding vs replication 51 raw SPAdes ≥1 kb). Different post-processing (MeDuSa) and versions plausibly explain; directionally consistent but not matched.
CDS count differs (6239 RASTtk vs 6085 Prodigal; 2.5% delta). Within expected gene-caller/toolchain variation, but not a direct reproduction of PATRIC/RASTtk.
N50 differs by 4.4% (273,159 vs 261,281 bp), within the stated ~5% tolerance.
Species assignment supported; 16S identity to PSE305 is 100% over full length, consistent/stronger than paper’s 99% and compatible with high ANI claim.

Presence of PLA-relevant enzyme families is supported by tblastn hits across hydrolase/lipase/esterase/protease/cutinase/depolymerase sets, but this is a reference-based family-presence check rather than reproducing the paper’s full functional annotation claims.
No S2 re-assembly; reference genomes are larger (5.90–5.96 Mb) than claimed 5.45 Mb (8–9% smaller). This is plausible for a draft but only indirectly corroborated.
S2 GC claim (43.66%) matches close references (~43.6%), supporting plausibility/species assignment, but not directly recomputed from an S2 assembly.
ANI/16S similarity not independently computed; only indirect corroboration via existence of close references and matching GC/size expectations.
EC-3 genome size claim (3.40 Mb) is plausible relative to a close complete reference (3.60 Mb), but not directly re-assembled/verified.
EC-3 GC claim (52.18%) is consistent with close reference (52.28%), but not directly recomputed from an EC-3 assembly.
ANI/16S similarity not independently computed; only indirect corroboration via reference availability and matching GC/size.
Project/run deposition verified via NCBI; all three runs are public and match the stated accessions; S3 reads were used for replication.
EC-3 spot/read count matches exactly (5,730,761). Discrepancy for S2/S3 counts is explainable by counting PE mates separately, but that is outside this specific claim.

justification: Core assembly-level metrics for S3 (genome size, GC, N50) and data deposition/read count claims are reproduced or within tolerance, and S3 species assignment is strongly supported. Several other claims (S2/EC-3 genome statistics and ANI values, and the broad functional-annotation claim) were only indirectly corroborated via reference comparisons or targeted homology checks without re-assembling/annotating those genomes using the same pipeline, so overall replication is partial rather than full.
